thm-alexander-whitney-and-eilenberg-zilb.clauses_read: Entire statement, facts and proof: natural AW/shuffle maps; simplex-model contractions; recursive natural inverse and homotopies; scalar extension; ordinary unnormalized chains.
thm-alexander-whitney-and-eilenberg-zilb.use_limit: Naturality preserves subspace chains. This supplier alone is not a relative open-pair theorem; the open-cover quotient argument was authored separately.

lem-relative-cohomological-kunneth-under.clauses_read: Entire statement, facts and proof: supplied CW-pair chain comparison; cycle/boundary sections; finite-basis evaluation inverse; chain deformation onto finite free homology; identification of the actual cross product.
lem-relative-cohomological-kunneth-under.use_limit: Its stated geometric hypothesis is CW pairs with supplied characteristic maps. For Milnor open complements, only the read algebraic proof is reused AFTER the separate open-pair AW comparison and finite relative homology have been proved.

lem-relative-singular-product-chain-equi.clauses_read: Entire statement, facts and proof, including naturality on the sum of subspace complexes, small-chain contraction of the union quotient, extension of that contraction by zero, and explicit quotient chain inverse.
lem-relative-singular-product-chain-equi.use_limit: The theorem is stated for CW pairs. Its HEP neighborhood construction is not imported for open Milnor pairs; the authored open-cover proof starts directly from the two open members.

thm-cover-small-inclusion-is-a-chain-hom.clauses_read: Entire statement and proof: finite affine subdivision/prism sums, simplex-dependent least subdivision counts, face-recursive maximum, chain retraction and homotopy, preservation of every subspace and arbitrary coefficient tensoring.
thm-cover-small-inclusion-is-a-chain-hom.use_limit: No uniform subdivision depth for all singular chains is inferred.

lem-two-open-cover-small-chains-are-the-.clauses_read: Entire two-step proof: generators identify the small-chain complex with the sum for an open cover; their intersection is the chain complex of the intersection.
lem-two-open-cover-small-chains-are-the-.use_limit: Used for the actual open cover of the product complement union.
